description: Every two-colouring of omega one with no uncountable homogeneous set has a countably infinite homogeneous set in colour one.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.sierpinski_countable_second_colour
  (c : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.PairColoring Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.OmegaOne)
  (hc :
    ∀ (H : Set Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.OmegaOne),
      ¬H.Countable → ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneous c H) :
  ∃ H, Cardinal.mk ↑H = Cardinal.aleph0 ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn c H 1
